import json

s = open('/tmp/exp1_arch.svg').read()
idx = s.find("<line x1='540' y1='202'")
head = s[:idx]
tail_close = "</svg>"
assert s.endswith(tail_close)

RED = "#8c2f1f"
FONT = "Palatino,Georgia,serif"

new_block = []

# dashed leader, same anchor geometry as exp1 (already validated by figcheck)
new_block.append(f"<line x1='540' y1='202' x2='284' y2='270' stroke='{RED}' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")

# glyph: three small capture-frames of the SAME lattice position, fanned
# diagonally (back->front = bb_dop20, truedop_2022, truedop_2023), one
# shared heading tick per frame, converging to a single cell label
frames = [(224, 252, .18), (233, 262, .26), (242, 272, .36)]
for (fx, fy, op) in frames:
    new_block.append(f"<rect x='{fx}' y='{fy}' width='16' height='16' fill='{RED}' fill-opacity='{op}' stroke='{RED}' stroke-width='1'/>")
    # shared heading tick, same angle on every frame
    cx, cy = fx + 8, fy + 8
    new_block.append(f"<line x1='{cx-4}' y1='{cy-2}' x2='{cx+5}' y2='{cy-9}' stroke='{RED}' stroke-width='0.8'/>")
    new_block.append(f"<path d='M {cx+5},{cy-9} l -4.5,.5 l 1.5,4 Z' fill='{RED}'/>")

conv_x, conv_y = 280, 294
for (fx, fy, op) in frames:
    cx, cy = fx + 8, fy + 8
    new_block.append(f"<line x1='{cx}' y1='{cy}' x2='{conv_x}' y2='{conv_y}' stroke='{RED}' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.6'/>")
new_block.append(f"<circle cx='{conv_x}' cy='{conv_y}' r='2.1' fill='{RED}'/>")

new_block.append(
    f"<text x='300' y='280' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='10' fill='{RED}' font-weight='600' "
    f"text-anchor='start' >one shared heading, sampled from ALL 3 training captures at once</text>"
)
new_block.append(
    f"<text x='300' y='292' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='9.5' fill='{RED}' font-weight='400' "
    f"text-anchor='start' >bb_dop20 + truedop_2022 + truedop_2023 share one cell label per step, in the same mini-batch</text>"
)

new_block.append(
    f"<text x='968' y='40' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='9.5' fill='#9b998c' font-weight='400' "
    f"text-anchor='end' font-style='italic'>deployed graph byte-identical — only which crops share a training step changed</text>"
)

svg = head + "".join(new_block) + tail_close
json.dump({"architecture_svg": svg}, open('/tmp/figwork/figure.json', 'w'))
print("done", len(svg))
PYEOF
.venv/bin/python -I /tmp/figwork/build.py
tool_input.description: Build the new figure.json from exp1's SVG with new training annotation
Copy figure.json and run figcheck validation

result:
figcheck passes. The figure for experiment 2 is written to `runs/20261030_101727_experiment2/figure.json`.

It reuses the unchanged inference path exactly as experiment 1 drew it (camera frame → encoder → cell classifier → 3×3 belief pooling → offset head → confidence gate → output, all in ink, since none of that changed), and replaces only the training-signal annotation: a new glyph showing three overlapping capture frames (bb_dop20, truedop_2022, truedop_2023) sharing one heading, converging to a single cell label — illustrating the paired-position interleave this experiment introduced, in red per the changed-element convention.
